text: Alcohol is not a drug because it is legal.
explanation: Alcohol is a psychoactive drug. Legal status does not determine whether something is a drug.

text: Most people who try marijuana become addicted.
explanation: Research shows about 9% of marijuana users develop dependence, lower than many other substances.

text: Tobacco kills half of all long-term users.
explanation: Half of all long-term tobacco users die from smoking-related causes.

text: You can get addicted on the first use.
explanation: While some substances can hook quickly, most addictions develop over repeated use.

text: Peer pressure is the biggest risk factor for teen substance use.
explanation: Peer pressure and social environment are major factors in teen substance initiation.
Physical activity releases endorphins and can help manage withdrawal symptoms.
Hookah smoking carries many of the same health risks as cigarette smoking.

text: Recovery means you never struggle again.
explanation: Recovery is a journey. Setbacks can happen but do not mean failure.

text: Methamphetamine can be prescribed by a doctor.
explanation: Methamphetamine (Desoxyn) is FDA-approved for ADHD and obesity in rare cases.

text: You cannot help someone who does not want help.
explanation: Motivation is essential for recovery, but support and education can plant seeds.
